title: HB 520 (2012 Regular Session): AN ACT relating to voter identification.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) Sec. 18, KRS 117.225(1)
(quote) (1) Any person desiring to vote on election day shall give his or her name and address to the [clerk of the] election clerk and shall provide proof of identification that matches the voter's voter identification number.
(section) Sec. 18, KRS 117.225(3)
(quote) (3) A voter who votes in person at a precinct polling place that is located at a state licensed care facility where the voter resides is not required to provide proof of identification before voting in an election.
(section) Sec. 19, KRS 117.227
(quote) Election officers shall confirm the identity of each voter by proof of identification[personal acquaintance or by a document, such as a motor vehicle operator's license, Social Security card, or credit card].
(section) Sec. 26, KRS 117.375(12)
(quote) (12) "Proof of identification" means a document that: (a) Was issued by the United States or the Commonwealth of Kentucky, and contains: 1. The name of the individual to whom the document was issued, and the name conforms to the name in the individual's voter registration record; 2. A photograph of the individual to whom the document was issued; and 3. An expiration date, and the document: a. Has not expired; or b. Expired after the date of the most recent regular election;
(b_no_id_remedy)
(section) Sec. 18, KRS 117.225(2)
(quote) (2) If the voter's name is listed on the precinct list furnished by the State Board of Elections as provided in KRS 117.025, but the voter is unable or declines to produce proof of identification, the voter may vote a provisional ballot under Section 1 of this Act as a provisional voter.
(section) Sec. 1 (new section of KRS ch. 117)
(quote) If a voter is unable or declines to produce proof of identification as required under Section 18 of this Act, the election clerk shall inform the voter that he or she may cast a provisional ballot if the individual: (a) Is eligible to vote under KRS 116.025; (b) Is entitled to vote in that precinct; and (c) In the presence of the election clerk, executes a provisional voter's affidavit furnished by the State Board of Elections stating:
(section) Sec. 2 (new section of KRS ch. 117)
(quote) (b) Either: 1. Proof of identification; or 2. A sworn statement as part of the affidavit in paragraph (a) of this subsection that the voter: a. Is indigent and unable to obtain proof of identification without the payment of a fee; or b. Has a religious objection to being photographed.
(c_mail_ballot_id)
(section) Sec. 6, KRS 117.075(1)
(quote) and a copy of his or her proof of identification.
(section) Sec. 6, KRS 117.075(1)
(quote) If the voter did not submit a copy of his or her proof of identification or the proof of identification did not match the voter's voter identification number, the clerk shall mail to the voter a provisional absentee ballot, a provisional absentee voter's affidavit, and envelopes, and the voter shall cast his or her vote in accordance with Section 10 of this Act, except that the provisional voter's affidavit shall be notarized.
(section) Sec. 7, KRS 117.077(1)
(quote) The application shall be notarized and accompanied by a copy of the voter's proof of identification.
(section) Sec. 8, KRS 117.085(2)
(quote) and the voter shall submit a copy of his or her proof of identification with the application.
(section) Sec. 8, KRS 117.085(3)(a)
(quote) (3) (a) If the county clerk finds that the voter is properly registered as stated in his or her application, his or her proof of identification matches the voter's voter identification number established in Section 4 of this Act, and the voter otherwise qualifies to receive an absentee ballot by mail, he or she shall mail to the voter an absentee ballot,
(section) Sec. 8, KRS 117.085(3)(b)
(quote) (b) If the voter does not submit a copy of his or her proof of identification, or the proof of identification does not match the voter's voter identification number established in Section 4 of this Act, and the voter otherwise qualifies to receive an absentee ballot by mail, the county clerk shall mail to the voter a provisional absentee ballot and the provisional voter's affidavit described in Section 1 of this Act, two (2) official envelopes for returning the ballot, and instructions for voting a provisional absentee ballot, which shall include the requirement that the affidavit be notarized.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule)
(section) Sec. 4, KRS 116.155(1)(b)-(3)
(quote) (b) The individual's driver's license number or personal identification number issued under KRS 186.412. (2) For purposes of satisfying the requirements under paragraph (b) of subsection (1) of this section, if an individual does not have a driver's license or personal identification card issued under KRS 186.412, the individual shall provide the last four (4) digits of the individual's Social Security number as provided under 42 U.S.C. sec. 15483(a)(5)
(section) Sec. 4, KRS 116.155(4)
(quote) (4) An individual's voter identification number shall not be changed unless: (a) The individual made an error when providing the number when registering to vote; (b) The county clerk's office made an error when entering the number into the voter registration records; (c) The individual obtains or provides a driver's license number or personal identification card number issued under KRS 186.412;
(section) Sec. 1, provisional affidavit item
(quote) 1. That the voter is a citizen of the United States;
(other) Sec. 3 (KRS 116.065): provisional and provisional absentee ballots added to the written-declaration-under-penalty-of-perjury rule.
(other) Sec. 5 (KRS 117.066): two ballot boxes moved to the county board of elections; cross-reference conformed.
(other) Sec. 9-17 (KRS 117.0851, 117.086, 117.0863, 117.0865, 117.087, 117.145, 117.175, 117.187, 117.195): provisional absentee ballots folded into absentee tabulation, instructions, separate provisional boxes and rosters, ballot printing, poll-worker training on proof of identification, and precinct supplies.
(other) Sec. 20 (KRS 117.245): challenge procedure does not apply to failure to provide proof of identification.
(other) Sec. 21-25 (KRS 117.255, 117.265, 117.275, 117.305, 117.365): spoiled-ballot, write-in, tabulation, recanvass and grand-jury rules extended to provisional ballots and affidavits.
(other) Sec. 26-38 (KRS 117.375 and later, 117.383, 117.385, 117.995, 118.015, 118.305, 118.405, 118A.xxx, 119.005, 120.005): definitions of provisional voter and ballot; ballot-card design and instructions; penalties and related chapters conformed (not read line by line for ID content beyond the above).
(other) version: bill (as introduced): carries ID text in slots a, b, c and e; the only saved version; no committee substitute or floor amendment exists in the record.
(other) note: Bill stopped in committee after introduction (actions end 2012-03-01 "to Elections ... (H)"). No roll calls (votes list empty). Underline marks are lost, but the bill reads as a full rewrite: ID-related words in Sec. 1, 2, 18 and 26 are new sections or new text; bracketed words are deleted. Sec. 19 deletes the old rule that identity could be confirmed by personal acquaintance or by a document such as a licence, Social Security card or credit card. The ID rule has no photo-ID sentence of its own: "proof of identification" (KRS 117.375(12)) is defined as a US or Kentucky-issued document with name matching the voter record, a photograph and an unexpired (or recently expired) date; military-issued documents may lack an expiry date. Voter ID number (KRS 116.155): licence/ID card number, else last four of SSN, else clerk-assigned number; in-person ID must "match" this number. Care-facility voters are exempt (117.225(3)). Mail ballot: copy of proof of identification must accompany the application; a missing or non-matching copy gets a provisional absentee ballot with a notarized affidavit. Provisional ballot cure: voter appears before the clerk or board by the recanvass deadline with an affidavit and proof of identification, or a sworn statement of indigence or religious objection to photographs. Citizenship appears only as one item in the provisional-ballot affidavit; no documentary proof or database check of citizenship (slot d: not stated).
